Title: It's Not Garlic or Coffee - 3 Everyday Habits Behind Bad Breath

Description:
The real culprits behind your breath might be in your wine glass, your fridge, and your medicine cabinet.

Dry mouth means less saliva, and bacteria multiply fast, breaking proteins into the sulfur compounds behind bad breath. Alcohol, dairy, and allergy medication all speed that up in their own way.

Watch to find out why, and what small habits actually help.
